notes.title: Spearhead Games' 7th Anniversary!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31655037/a72c3e56bdc5a212d7fcc8928a09f9115bc933b7.jpg

It feels amazing to say, but we’re celebrating seven years of being a studio, which is an accomplishment we’re all so proud of. We founded Spearhead with high hopes for being successful enough to keep making the kind of games we were passionate about, and to be able to make them how we wanted to. Now that we’re looking back over the last seven years of doing just that, it means so much that we get to continue working at those goals.

As of right now, we’re working hard on Project Witchstone, our newest title. An RPG with a storyline generated in reaction to player choice in a reactive, vibrant world where factions vie for control of an isolated continent and the mysterious magic of the Witchstones. It would mean a lot if you’d go give Witchstone a look and consider adding it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1064120/Project_Witchstone/

Anniversary Sale: October 16 to 23
We’ll be running a sale on Stories: The Path of Destinies and Omensight as part of the seven years of Spearhead anniversary celebration, so make sure to pick up a copy before October 23rd if you want to get a deal.

From everyone here at Spearhead, thank you for all of your support over the years, and we’re excited to keep pushing to do new and exciting things to repay it.

notes.title: Free update now available!
notes.content:
Today a new and totally free update of Tiny Brains is now available.  Based on community feedback, we've added lots of new content, and also improved on the existing game.


New challenges in the new "Road to Stardom" game mode, including the Infernal Carousel, Battle of Sphereburg, and Matrix Ball
New star-based progression and scoring system in "Road to Stardom".  Can you reach all the stars and unlock all the levels?
Souped-up superpower for the Minsc the hamster -- Now, he can freeze objects with his ice blocks!
Updated user interface that allows players to better navigate throughout modes and challenges

With the new price of 9.99$, its a steal! ;)
